title: Branch on Linux
notes:
- Branch now runs on Linux. the AppImage updates itself like the Windows version
- the mod manager finds Gorilla Tag in Linux Steam folders

title: New sidebar and Library
notes:
- cleaned up the sidebar
- favorites, recently viewed and your watchlist now live together in Library
- 58 more mods

title: Creator accounts
notes:
- optional accounts, just a username and password
- edit your mods after uploading them and post new versions
- the creator hub and robux rewards need an account. uploading doesn't

title: Mod manager
notes:
- link your Gorilla Tag folder to turn mods on and off, update them, remove them or scan them
- install mods into the game with one click
- screenshots and youtube videos on mod pages
- polls in Community

title: Hundreds of new mods
notes:
- 300+ new mods, including a Menus category
- every mod downloads straight from Branch now
- mods without a thumbnail get a generated cover

title: Creator hub and Watchlist
notes:
- creator hub with levels, badges and download stats
- mods linked to github update themselves
- watchlist: paste any github link and get told when a new version is out

title: First-time setup
notes:
- new setup and tour when you first open Branch
- you can turn Branch AI off completely in settings
- safety scores are fairer

title: Inbox
notes:
- inbox for announcements, update notes and replies to your reports
- new backgrounds
- redesigned Tree of Life

title: Easy upload and ratings
notes:
- drop in a .dll and the listing gets written for you
- star ratings, and Featured is now the top rated mods
- upload mods from the Discord server

title: Auto updates
notes:
- Branch updates itself now
- Ask Branch, a free AI helper
- Player Tracker (beta)
- animated backgrounds
